senses.gloss: m. (כָּחַח) coughing, phlegm of the lungs.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 99a:17">Erub. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>בכִיחוֹ</he> it refers to the phlegm in his mouth.

<cite ref="Eruvin 99a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>כיחו שנתלש</he> phlegm which is loose in the mouth. [<cite ref="Eruvin 99a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>כיח ורק</he>, <he>כ׳ בפני</he>, v. <cite ref="K00459"><he>כָּחַח</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 3b:5">B. Kam. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>כיחו וניעו</he> the phlegm brought out by coughing or hawking.
<cite ref="Niddah 56a:50">Ib. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>כיחו וניעו ורוקי</he> phlegm, mucus and spittle (prob. to be read <he>כרוקו</he>).
